public_rationale: The distribution proposition is supported. The DOJ reports admitted illegal exports of NVIDIA GPUs, and reporting from the court documents describes shell-company financing and intermediary routing to China. This establishes an actual route, rather than only an attempted shipment. It does not establish the stronger contextual allegation that NVIDIA knowingly coordinated the scheme.
limitations: The result depends on reading the sentence as a claim about distribution through intermediaries.
Knowing NVIDIA participation remains unestablished by these items.
Court-document reporting supplements the official summary because the PDFs could not be extracted.
The evidence concerns a completed multiyear pattern, not a shipment on the publication date.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: NVIDIA is selling GPUs to China through proxies and shell corporations.

statement.excerpt: It’s impossible to argue that NVIDIA is not selling GPUs to China through a web of proxies and shell corporations — and now the only real questions are how much, to whom, and when.

from_speaker: NVIDIA is not selling GPUs to China
through a web of proxies and shell corporations
the only real questions are how much, to whom, and when
our_interpretation: The factual core is that NVIDIA GPUs are sold onward to Chinese customers through intermediary and shell-company networks.
This reading does not require proof that NVIDIA executives directed or knowingly authorized the downstream evasion. The surrounding allegations of deliberate conduct are stronger and remain separate.
The target is the continuing distribution pattern described in the multiyear account through publication, not transactions in an arbitrarily selected month.
The speaker supplies no exact starting date and expressly leaves quantities, buyers and timing open.
criteria.support_condition: Documented completed sales or shipments establish that NVIDIA GPUs reached Chinese customers through a network involving intermediaries and shell companies. Attempted shipments alone are insufficient.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable records disprove the alleged completed distribution routes or establish that the relevant chips did not reach Chinese customers through such networks. A denial concerning one intermediary is insufficient to disprove the general pattern.
